# Assets · Icons

24 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for add.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

A representative subset (24 of ~400) of Gestalt's icon library, copied verbatim from `packages/gestalt/src/icons/*.svg` in pinterest/gestalt. All 24 are single-ink marks (no `fill` attribute set in the source — they render solid black); recolor via the path `fill` or wrap in an element that sets `color` and reference it, to use on a dark ground or match a semantic icon token (e.g. `icon-default`, `icon-subtle`).

Included: add, arrow-back, arrow-forward, bell, calendar, camera, check, clock, download, edit, ellipsis, eye, filter, flag, folder, globe, heart, lock, pin, play, search, share, star, trash-can.

The full set (~400 icons, covering actions, media, navigation, social, and Pinterest-specific concepts like Idea Pins and shopping) lives at `packages/gestalt/src/icons/` in the source repository and is consumed in the product via Gestalt's `Icon` component (pass the bare name, e.g. `icon="heart"`). Ask for more icons brought in by name if this subset isn't enough for what you're building.
